Title: Add privacy and performance guardrails to OTel instrumentation.
Description: Apply mandatory guardrails so telemetry does not leak sensitive data or degrade runtime performance. Include bounded path filters, low-cardinality operation tags, configurable sampling percentage, and explicit avoidance of raw prompt/query/content payload attributes. Acceptance criteria: noisy endpoints can be excluded by config, high-cardinality text and identifiers are not emitted as OTel attributes, sampling is configurable and bounded, and default configuration favors low overhead.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Guardrails task captures anti-pitfall requirements: no sensitive payload tags, bounded dimensions, configurable sampling, and endpoint filters.
